rationale: HyC-LoRA introduces a hybrid activation-compression framework that enables nearly 2-bit buffered activation quantization across LoRA training operators. Its inter-operator reordering/fusion and quantization-based activation storage require operator-level support, matching the precision-format and fusion-family categories.

Radius is a gradient sparsity and communication-compression algorithm for large foundation-model pre-training. It reduces allreduce communication volume but does not propose a new compute kernel, precision format implementation, or kernel-generation system.

XGrammar accelerates structured generation by optimizing grammar execution, token-mask generation, persistent stacks, and overlap with LLM inference. These are constrained-decoding runtime/data-structure optimizations rather than accelerator kernels or kernel-generation tooling.

FlexAttention is a compiler-driven programming model that generates optimized fused attention kernels from concise PyTorch definitions of attention variants. It directly matches the compiler/DSL and fused-kernel categories in the codebook.

NEO improves online LLM inference by offloading attention compute and KV-cache state to CPU and using asymmetric GPU-CPU pipelining plus load-aware scheduling. The core contribution is heterogeneous serving/offloading policy rather than a new kernel or compiler-generated kernel.

AdaParse selects among PDF parsers and scales resources for scientific-document parsing campaigns to create text corpora for LLM training. It is a data-ingestion and resource-orchestration system, not a kernel-style optimization.

FlexInfer dynamically chooses CPU/GPU execution policies for prefill and decode in offload-based LLM inference. It is phase-aware runtime scheduling over existing CPU/GPU computations rather than contributing new kernels.

The paper formalizes and mitigates perception and decision uncertainty in multimodal foundation-model planning using conformal prediction, formal-methods-driven prediction, active sensing, and refinement. These are model-reliability and planning methods, not kernel-level system optimizations.

This paper introduces and analyzes ML-specific supply-chain attacks and studies security awareness in open-source ML projects. The contribution is security analysis of ML frameworks, not kernel or compiler optimization.

technique_name: context parallelism / pass-KV and pass-Q ring attention
rationale: The paper develops lossless ring-attention variants, pass-KV and pass-Q, to partition long-context attention computation and KV storage across GPUs for prefill and decode. Because it changes attention work partitioning and collective execution for an LLM compute primitive, it is a kernel-style scheduling/layout optimization.

Marconi designs prefix-cache admission and eviction policies for hybrid LLM serving, forecasting reuse and compute savings to improve token hit rates. Prefix caching is a serving-system policy above kernels.

Venn is a collaborative-learning resource manager that schedules ephemeral heterogeneous devices among multiple CL jobs. Its contribution is resource scheduling and device-to-job matching, not kernel-level optimization.
